children: Tokyo Electron's price negotiations with customers will likely contribute to a higher gross margin over time, Jefferies analysts say in a note. The Japanese chip-production equipment maker targets gross profit margin hitting 48.3% in 2H after it reached 47.4% in 1H. Tokyo Electron periodically conducts negotiations for existing processes with major customers, the analysts note. Since the company hasn't been aggressive with price negotiations up until now, they expect some effects to manifest in the coming quarters. Tokyo Electron aims for a gross margin of 50% for the fiscal year starting April 2027, partly through increased sales, especially of higher value-added products, they say. Jefferies has a buy rating and a target price of 13,000 yen on the stock. Shares closed 2.8% higher at Y8,940. (kosaku.narioka@wsj.com; @kosakunarioka)
